constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (school_id, contract_id) REFERENCES training_contract(school_id, contract_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, file_id) REFERENCES file_object(school_id, file_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, result_version_id) REFERENCES document_version(school_id, document_version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, id) REFERENCES operation_receipt(school_id, command_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_version_id) REFERENCES template_version(school_id, template_version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_version_id) REFERENCES document_version(school_id, document_version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_id, active_version_id) REFERENCES template_version(school_id, template_id, template_version_id) DEFERRABLE
CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM basis_schema_version)) > 0) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM renderer_version)) > 0)))
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, basis_file_id) REFERENCES file_object(school_id, file_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_id, enrollment_id) REFERENCES training_document(school_id, document_id, enrollment_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, rendered_file_id) REFERENCES file_object(school_id, file_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_version_id) REFERENCES template_version(school_id, template_version_id) DEFERRABLE

CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Prepared'::character varying, 'Indeterminate'::character varying, 'PublishedReview'::character varying, 'PublishedReady'::character varying, 'Stale'::character varying, 'Withdrawn'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, signed_copy_id) REFERENCES contract_signed_copy(school_id, signed_copy_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, version_id) REFERENCES document_version(school_id, document_version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, file_id) REFERENCES file_object(school_id, file_id)
CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM storage_key)) > 0) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM media_type)) > 0)))
CHECK (((purpose)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Template'::character varying, 'Rendered'::character varying, 'SignedCopy'::character varying, 'SourceBasis'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, id) REFERENCES operation_receipt(school_id, command_id)

CHECK (((((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Pending'::character varying, 'Indeterminate'::character varying])::text[])) AND (completed_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Succeeded'::character varying, 'Rejected'::character varying])::text[])) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((template_version_id IS NULL) OR (template_id IS NOT NULL)))
CHECK ((((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['Succeeded'::character varying, 'Rejected'::character varying])::text[])) OR (outcome_code IS NOT NULL)))
CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM operation)) > 0) AND ((outcome_code IS NULL) OR (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM outcome_code)) > 0))))
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, contract_id) REFERENCES training_contract(school_id, contract_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_id) REFERENCES training_document(school_id, document_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_version_id) REFERENCES document_version(school_id, document_version_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_id) REFERENCES document_template(school_id, template_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_id, template_version_id) REFERENCES template_version(school_id, template_id, template_version_id) DEFERRABLE
CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Pending'::character varying, 'Succeeded'::character varying, 'Rejected'::character varying, 'Indeterminate'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_version_id) REFERENCES document_version(school_id, document_version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, id) REFERENCES operation_receipt(school_id, command_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, contract_id) REFERENCES training_contract(school_id, contract_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_version_id) REFERENCES document_version(school_id, document_version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, file_id) REFERENCES file_object(school_id, file_id)
CHECK (((template_version_id IS NULL) OR (template_id IS NOT NULL)))
CHECK (((signed_copy_id IS NULL) OR (contract_id IS NOT NULL)))
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, command_id) REFERENCES operation_receipt(school_id, command_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, contract_id) REFERENCES training_contract(school_id, contract_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, contract_id, signed_copy_id) REFERENCES contract_signed_copy(school_id, contract_id, signed_copy_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_id) REFERENCES training_document(school_id, document_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_version_id) REFERENCES document_version(school_id, document_version_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_id) REFERENCES document_template(school_id, template_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_id, template_version_id) REFERENCES template_version(school_id, template_id, template_version_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, file_id) REFERENCES file_object(school_id, file_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_id) REFERENCES document_template(school_id, template_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, basis_file_id) REFERENCES file_object(school_id, file_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, enrollment_id, replaces_contract_id) REFERENCES training_contract(school_id, enrollment_id, contract_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, generated_file_id) REFERENCES file_object(school_id, file_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, template_version_id) REFERENCES template_version(school_id, template_version_id) DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (school_id, document_id, current_version_id) REFERENCES document_version(school_id, document_id, document_version_id) DEFERRABLE
